title: What Happens to a Private Boat Trip in Madeira if the Weather Is Bad?
description: If the sea is not safe, the skipper cancels your Madeira boat trip and you choose another date or a full refund. Here is who decides, how, and what counts.
heroAlt: White water breaking beyond the harbour wall in Funchal while boats stay moored inside the marina
keywords: what happens to a boat trip in Madeira if the weather is bad
boat trip refund bad weather Funchal
is the sea too rough for a boat trip Madeira
